entry.title: MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 Tutorial
entry.content:
I prepared a tutorial for the MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 on when model explanations can be misleading in medical imaging.

The tutorial is available as a static website, with the source code and materials hosted on GitHub.

  • Tutorial: When Explanations Lie
  • Code and materials: github.com/Kirscher/when-explanations-lie
entry.summary: Tutorial materials for the MICCAI Educational Challenge 2026 on misleading explanations in medical imaging.
